objects.taxonomy_description: Ring-shaped bread roll with a glossy, chewy crust and dense interior crumb. The toroidal form features a central hole approximately 2-3 cm in diameter with an overall diameter of 10-12 cm. The surface exhibits a smooth, shiny glaze from boiling before baking, with golden-brown to deep amber coloration. Texture shows a firm exterior with slight blistering and a dense, chewy interior. May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

objects.taxonomy_description: Adult male bird exhibiting pronounced sexual dimorphism from female. Body is compact and robust measuring 30-70 cm in length depending on species. Plumage is characterized by vivid, iridescent coloration with metallic green, blue, purple, or copper tones on the neck, breast, and tail feathers. Hackle feathers (neck plumage) are elongated, pointed, and glossy, forming a distinctive ruff around the neck. Saddle feathers (lower back) are elongated and flowing. Tail feathers are long, curved, and iridescent with a characteristic arching posture. Comb is a fleshy, serrated crest on the crown, bright red and vascularized; size and shape vary by breed. Wattles are paired fleshy appendages hanging from the lower beak, also bright red. Beak is short, curved, and keratinous with a yellow to grey coloration. Legs are stout with thick, scaled skin and a prominent posterior spur (calcified projection) on the tarsus used in combat. Feet are anisodactyl (three toes forward, one backward) with sharp, curved claws. The bird exhibits an upright, alert posture with chest puffed and tail elevated.

Head_and_Face: Comb is a fleshy, serrated crest on the crown, bright red and vascularized.
Wattles are paired fleshy appendages hanging from the lower beak, bright red.
Beak is short, curved, and keratinous with a yellow to grey coloration.
Eyes are dark and positioned laterally.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is vivid and iridescent with metallic green, blue, purple, or copper tones on the neck, breast, and tail feathers.
Hackle feathers (neck plumage) are elongated, pointed, and glossy, forming a distinctive ruff.
Saddle feathers (lower back) are elongated and flowing.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are stout with thick, scaled skin and a prominent posterior spur on the tarsus.
Feet are anisodactyl (three toes forward, one backward) with sharp, curved claws.
Tail feathers are long, curved, and iridescent with a characteristic arching posture.

objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.
